annotations.title: EVM & Move Smart Contract Honeypot, Tax & Reentrancy Auditor

description: Statically audits Solidity, Vyper, or Move smart contract source code for honeypot transfer taxes, hidden mint backdoors, proxy upgrade traps, and reentrancy. Use when auditing smart contract source code or bytecode before deploying or interacting with a protocol; for scanning Solana Anchor/Rust programs specifically for Cross-Program Invocation (CPI) signer/account vulnerabilities, use scan_solana_cpi_reentrancy instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'code_or_address' ('chain' defaults to 'evm_solidity'), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (45 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

chain.description: Target blockchain VM architecture; defaults to 'evm_solidity' when omitted.

code_or_address.description: Smart contract source code snippet, ABI, or contract address to audit.

name: audit_smart_contract_code

is_honeypot.description: True if transfer restrictions or excessive sell taxes (>10%) are present.

security_score.description: Composite contract safety score from 0 (critical exploit) to 100 (verified safe).

vulnerabilities.description: Specific vulnerability findings and line-level remediation advice.

title: EVM & Move Smart Contract Honeypot, Tax & Reentrancy Auditor
